name: Apply Ceiling Finish (Spray + Backroll)
intent: Spray ceiling finish coat and immediately backroll the wet film. Ceiling NC finish standard for QT3+. Faster per SF than rolling but requires the ceiling and wall edge to be masked already (handled in protection/setup phase). One coat per invocation; scenarios list twice with interstage for QT4/5.
doctrine: Spray rate (450 SF/hr) and backroll rate (320 SF/hr) are flat across coats and tiers — the QT modifier stack handles QT4/QT5 slowdown. Backroll is the bottleneck (the sprayer waits for the backroller to keep up). Source spec restricts spray_backroll to QT3+ because QT2 economy doesn't justify the two-person crew.
